character.appendages: No arms, legs, feet, wings or separate tail. The narrow lower lobe and horizontal sweep are deformations of the same continuous body and must not become independent anatomy.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [31,38]. Upright and compact poses generally contact near y=37-39. Cell_062 reuses the flat horizontal pose and cell_063 reuses the diagonal pose with the source translation [4,6]; preserve both mappings.
character.faceAndExpression: A large pale oval facial aperture sits high on the front. A red inner opening appears, widens, narrows or becomes hidden according to the source cell; low cells reduce the aperture to small marks or fully occlude it.
character.locomotion: The whole body bobs, settles, stretches upright, bends diagonally, sweeps horizontally and collapses low. No donor action semantics are renamed or invented.
character.morphology: Tiny limbless aquatic larva formed by one continuous soft droplet body. Upright poses narrow into a short trailing lower lobe; low poses compress the same body into a mound or horizontal sweep.
character.restraint: Main cells 027-043 form the restrained block, including sameAs aliases. A gold-brown binding crosses the lower-central body and follows compact, upright and tilted poses while leaving the facial aperture readable.
character.specialStates: Cells 044/046 are orange-red, 047/048 black silhouettes, 061 stone-gray and 064 white evolution silhouette. Derive them deterministically from accepted original poses whenever the reviewed alpha contour permits.
